name: RichAnanas Connector
author: vmtechdoo

sections.description:
RichAnanas Connector connects Your WooCommerce store to RichAnanas Studio, a SaaS operations platform for sellers working with Ananas marketplace.

The plugin is not a product editor. Product decisions, Ananas credentials, subscription rules, queues and synchronization logic are managed in RichAnanas Studio. The plugin acts as a secure WooCommerce bridge.

Main capabilities:

  • Connect WooCommerce to RichAnanas Studio with a Plugin Token.
  • Import catalog data prepared in RichAnanas into WooCommerce.
  • Synchronize product names, descriptions, images, categories, attributes, prices and stock.
  • Send WooCommerce stock, base prices and dated promotions to Ananas through RichAnanas Studio.
  • Run manual bulk updates or configure safe stock, base-price and promotion schedules.
  • Send WooCommerce order events to RichAnanas.
  • Show connection status, plan status and readable logs inside WordPress.

External Services

This plugin connects to RichAnanas Studio at https://richananas.rs. A RichAnanas account and Plugin Token are required. The plugin sends store metadata, catalog synchronization results, selected commercial snapshots, logs and selected WooCommerce order events to RichAnanas Studio according to Your settings. Ananas API credentials are not stored in WordPress by this plugin.

Service provider: VMTech DOO Beograd.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the richananas-connector folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in WordPress.
  3. Open the RichAnanas menu item in WordPress admin.
  4. Create a WooCommerce Plugin Token in RichAnanas Studio.
  5. Paste the token into the Connection screen.
  6. Review product, price, stock and order policies.
  7. Run the first catalog synchronization.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin store Ananas API credentials in WordPress?

No. Ananas credentials stay inside RichAnanas Studio.

Can I use the plugin without WooCommerce?

No. WooCommerce is required.

Does the plugin edit products directly in Ananas?

No. Ananas operations are handled by RichAnanas Studio.
